name: Saikoro de Bakuhatsu Sunzen!!
source:
Enjoy the cute and slightly lewd lives of Joekira in this ADV game style sound novel!
The two innocent characters end up having their "first time" with the power of the dice!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ253009.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在这部ADV游戏风格的声音小说中享受Joekira可爱又略带淫荡的生活！
两个无辜的角色最终迎来了骰子力量的“第一次”！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ253009.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
